cohort: This study included pregnant women admitted to the Obstetrics Intensive Care Unit (OICU) of the "Maternidad Dr. Armando Castillo Plaza" complicated with HELLP syndrome between 2011 and 2015.
finding: The prevalence of HELLP syndrome was higher than reported in national and international studies, with the most prevalent clinical characteristics being preterm pregnancies, history of abortions, primiparous women, absent or inadequate prenatal care, singleton pregnancies, preeclampsia, history of pre-existing conditions, and cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 74.77% of the participants.
